acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test register() creates file, appends entry, returns a valid UUID.
Test register() with existing entries preserves them.
Test unregister() removes the correct entry by ID.
Test unregister() is a no-op for unknown ID.
Test register() handles corrupt/missing file gracefully (resets to []).
Test atomic write (no partial writes observable).

summary: All 12 unit tests pass. Full orchestrator regression suite: 978 passed, 6 skipped (pre-existing), 0 failures. All 7 acceptance criteria verified by direct test execution.

comments.note: No test covers unregister() removing the last entry (queue becomes []). Code handles it correctly via the filter logic, but an explicit test would document the intent.
Concurrent-write safety is exercised only via test_filelock.py integration; consider an async/subprocess stress test for multi-process scenarios if the queue becomes a bottleneck.
